headlines.title: How DoorDash’s DashOS, Retail Push, AI Tools, And Drone Network At DoorDash (DASH) Has Changed Its Investment Story
headlines.summary: In late September 2026, DoorDash announced a wave of product and partner launches, including the DashOS restaurant platform, an expanded retail Marketplace with brands such as Macy’s and Anthropologie, new AI tools for Dashers and corporate ordering, and DoorDash Air, its end-to-end drone delivery system.

headlines.title: Teladoc, Carvana, Wayfair, DoorDash, and Coinbase Stocks Trade Down, What You Need To Know
headlines.summary: A number of stocks fell in the afternoon session after the major indices pulled back and tech-oriented equities fell as the Bureau of Labor Statistics reported a hotter-than-expected September inflation print, pushing Treasury yields higher.

headlines.title: What Is DoorDash (DASH) Building With Loyalty Tools Across 80,000 Restaurants?
headlines.summary: DoorDash (NasdaqGS:DASH) is rolling out new loyalty and marketing tools to more than 80,000 restaurants that use third-party POS systems. The tools form part of the wider DashOS platform and are designed to help restaurants run automated rewards and targeted customer campaigns. DoorDash is positioning DashOS as an engagement and data layer that connects restaurant ordering channels with customer recognition features.

headlines.title: Pear VC Raises $333M Fund V to Double Down on Finding Founders Before the Market Does
headlines.summary: MENLO PARK, Calif., October 14, 2026--Pear VC today announced the close of its $333 million Fund V, bringing the firm’s total assets under management to more than $1.1 billion. Pear also announced the promotion of Arash Afrakhteh, Ajay Kamat, and Shravan Reddy to General Partner.

headlines.title: Uber (UBER) vs. DoorDash (DASH): Is Faster Growth Worth Paying More For?
headlines.summary: Uber Technologies, Inc. (NYSE:UBER) and DoorDash, Inc. (NASDAQ:DASH) have returned -1% and 22% over the past six months, compared to a 21.25% return for the Insider Monkey Billionaire Index and 14% for State Street SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust, as of October 12. Uber and DoorDash are both expanding beyond their original businesses.

description: DoorDash, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates a commerce platform that connects merchants, consumers, and dashers in the United States and internationally. The company operates DoorDash Marketplace, Wolt Marketplace, and Deliveroo Marketplace, which provide various services, such as customer acquisition, demand generation, order fulfillment, merchandising, payment processing, and customer support. It also offers consumer membership programs, DashPass, Wolt+, and Deliveroo Plus; advertising as a value-added service through its marketplaces; and white-label delivery fulfillment services, as well as services that help merchants establish online ordering, build branded mobile apps, manage reservations and in-store dining, manage consumer relationships, enable tableside order and pay, and improve customer support. The company was formerly known as Palo Alto Delivery Inc. and changed its name to DoorDash, Inc. in 2015. DoorDash, Inc. was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.
